## Academic publications

The full list is available on {{< ai orcid >}} [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7779-481X) and {{< ai google-scholar >}} [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=p1Tq4esAAAAJ).

```{r,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scholar)
library(knitr)

id <- "p1Tq4esAAAAJ"

scholar::get_publications(id) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(desc(year), desc(cites)) %>%
  transmute(
    Title = title,
    Journal = journal,
    Year = year,
    Citations = cites
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```
